name: mcode_test
description: Run a test/smoke-test command in the background inside the sprite, polling until it finishes (up to 10 min). Returns a run { id, status, exit_code, output }. Use for e.g. 'cargo test', 'npm test', 'pytest'. Requires write scope.

cmd.description: Test command, e.g. 'cargo test' or 'npm test'.
